title: Easing Visualizer
description: See CSS easing functions in action — the curve drawn on canvas plus a live animated dot and box for each easing.
howto: Pick an easing function from the list.
Watch the curve draw on the canvas and the dot animate along it.
Copy the CSS timing function for your own animations.

faqs.a: A math curve that controls how an animation accelerates: linear moves at constant speed, ease-in starts slow, ease-out ends slow, and so on.

faqs.q: What do the CSS keywords map to?
faqs.a: ease = cubic-bezier(0.25,0.1,0.25,1), ease-in = (0.42,0,1,1), ease-out = (0,0,0.58,1), ease-in-out = (0.42,0,0.58,1). The rest use standard Robert Penner formulas.
Switch the dropdown while watching — the animation restarts each time, so back-and-forth comparison is easy.
